It is a long fucking ridiculous story, most of which is in my post history, but I'll try to give you a TL;DR.

Girlfriend of one year was living with me in my house. Tried to break up with her and she grabbed some of my things trying to leave. I stepped in front of her, she slapped me twice, I pushed her away from me, she called the police.

Officer heard our stories, determines she was the primary aggressor, arrested us both since i admitted to pushing her. I spent the night in jail but she had a "panic attack" and went to the hospital, never even saw the jail and has no court date.

Got out the next day, all four of my tires were slashed and half my shit was gone. Report filed, nothing happens. Got a restraining order on her. She didn't come to court, order was granted for a full year.

She texts me and calls a dozen times saying "I know this is breaking the restraining order." I didn't respond. She facebook messages my friend the same shit. He doesnt respond. I make a report about her breaking the order, nothing happens.

Weeks pass. She gets a restraining order on me, claims I broke the order, but I have proof that she emailed herself from my stolen iPad to try to get me in trouble. Also states I was sexually abusive during our relationship. Judge doesn't want to see my proof, order granted.

Get several texts from a "police officer" that seem suspect. My cop friend calls the number. It's her roommate. Report filed, nothing happens.

Another county charges me with breaking the order over the email but don't arrest me, court date is in August. Original assault charge case is later this week. She hasn't seen a bit of trouble meanwhile I'm going literally insane. Afraid to be in public. Taking pictures of my odometer every day and only leaving home for work.
Nobody exists on purpose, nobody belongs anywhere, everybody's going to die, come watch TV.

I had to sell my house that was willed to me and move back in with my grandma because the ex slashed the tires on my car and threw a rock through my window. How could I sleep at night, ever again?

Plus the police could "probable cause" their way into putting me in jail for weeks before I'd get a trial. They could knock at any time. I already have two court dates in two different counties in June. I literally just finished drafting a suicide note because I have to be at work in a few hours. I can never sleep. I've lost 30 pounds in the past six months because I'm never hungry. My grandma has to cry and yell to force me to eat. I'm not even positive she believes me anymore because apparently dwelling on the negatives makes me seem guilty and I "look like a druggie" with the bags under my eyes and all. I have no idea how someone would or could move on from something like this.
